_comment: TRUST POLICY for the source-ingest role — GitHub Actions OIDC, no static keys.
Ingest is the only path that WRITES to the archive, so its trust is narrower
than the read role's in two further ways:
1. It is pinned to its own GitHub Environment (`${ingest_environment}`),
which carries required reviewers. A run that writes to the compliance
archive waits for a human to approve it.
2. It is pinned to ONE workflow file via the `job_workflow_ref` claim, so
even inside that environment, only source-ingest.yml can assume it. A new
workflow added to the repository cannot quietly acquire write access to
